server.how_the_data_got_there: `app.services.seed_demo(session)` called once in this lane's own process against a file that did not exist before it (db_setup_r1.py), plus one instrument marker row (db_marker_r1.py). `POST /api/v1/demo/reset` was never called; the server served that same lane-owned file, and no shared store was opened anywhere in this order.

ownership.note: /api/v1/health publishes e2e_run_id and e2e_database_id only for a run that set CITYNEXUS_E2E_RUN_ID; this server deliberately did not (see the comment in main()).  The store is named by the marker probe below.
